captions.detailed: A handheld, matte-black consumer camcorder. It features a main rectangular body with a side hand strap, a cylindrical front lens barrel with a grey glass lens, and a rectangular side display panel. The lens barrel rotates continuously around the viewing axis, and the side display panel pivots outward on a vertical revolute hinge.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a handheld camcorder with a rectangular main body, a side hand strap, a front-facing cylindrical lens barrel, and a side-mounted rectangular display screen. The lens barrel should have continuous rotation about its axis, and the display panel should rotate outward via a vertical hinge.
captions.factory: The code constructs the main body using a rectangular box and adds a curved strap on the side. The lens barrel is built from concentric cylinder primitives aligned along the longitudinal axis. The display screen is modeled as a rectangular box attached to the side of the body via a revolute joint, while the lens barrel is connected to the front via a continuous rotational joint.
